status: Qualified source change in private desktop export; not a new delivery package

implementation.enabled: Volume High sky, both supported desktop renderers. Existing Low, moving sheet, reflection and ground-shadow sources retained.
implementation.algorithm: Compute conservative union of the admitted vertical profiles once per ray. Skip the empty prefix with the original t/segment multiplication recurrence and stop after the empty suffix. Retain every surviving sample position, 192/5 High integration, half-resolution sky pass, density, light march, weather phases and composition.
bounds_proof: Stratus support is within [0,.13]: bottom=.012*w.y >=0, top=.08+.05*w.y <=.13.
Cumulus bottom cb=.125+.05*w.y-.05*sqrt(wc) >=.075. Top ct=.155+.05*w.y+sqrt(wc)*(.25+.30*w.y) <=.755 for w.y,wc in [0,1].

Admit each profile whenever its weight can be nonzero in clamp(type_base +/- abs(type_spread),0,1); take the union and expand by .0001 normalized height (.36m) for floating-point boundaries. Rays already require positive y, so the sampled altitude is monotone.
implementation.resources: No additional GPU textures, passes or globals. One lazily generated source string.
implementation.settings: No new options or default changes; independent shadows/reflections and .8/.9 fixes retained.

source_acceptance.hdr_scope: Eleven weather/type scenarios, two step counts, five eye heights below/inside/above the layer. Exact captured HDR scattering and transmittance against frozen pre-optimization integrator; both tests additionally prove unchanged surface COMMON and High-only sky selection.

performance_acceptance.scope: Actual integrated source versus complete reference shader within one process, 3840x2160 sky-only view on Linux RTX3090 Ti, same moving cloud interval 424.2667..430.25s. ABBA, 2.5s preheat per program, 256 warmup and 360 measured frames per arm. Parent viewport GPU timestamps; background radiance generation retained. No whole-game FPS or Windows/Android hardware claim.
